title: Warm Crunchy Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Jamaican dish featuring garlicky and crunchy chicken skewers, served in a molcajete vessel. This dairy-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, dry white wine, garlic, jamaican jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Roll the chicken skewers in panko breadcrumbs to coat evenly.
Place the skewers in a molcajete vessel or a stone-bowl-dolsot and bake for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve the warm crunchy Jamaican chicken skewers hot and enjoy.
